title: Bounded finite-free replacement for one degree of residue-field homology
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $F$ a cochain complex of $A$-modules, $b\in\mathbb Z$ an upper support bound ($F^n=0$ for $n>b$), and suppose every term of $F$ is finite free. For any $i\in\mathbb Z$ there is a bounded complex $K$ of finite free $A$-modules such that, for every prime $p\in\operatorname{Spec} A$, $\dim_{\kappa(p)}H^i(F\otimes_A\kappa(p))=\dim_{\kappa(p)}H^i(K\otimes_A\kappa(p))$.

proof.text: Construct K concretely as F.stupidTrunc of embeddingUpIntGE (i-1). Mathlib instances give lower bound i-1 and preserve the upper support bound b. This does not require i-1 <= b.

Below i-1 its terms are zero (isZero_stupidTrunc_X), hence subsingleton and finite free of rank zero. In retained degrees stupidTruncXIso is a module isomorphism to F; transport Free and Finite with Module.Free.of_equiv and Module.Finite.equiv.

Use extend_d_eq and restriction_d_eq to prove the term isomorphisms commute with differentials between retained degrees. Map the term isomorphisms through extension of scalars and use map_comp to retain these commutation equations.

In degrees i-1, i, i+1 these isomorphisms define a ShortComplex.isoMk. Convert from explicit to canonical indices using isoSc′. ShortComplex.homologyMapIso yields the homology isomorphism; its underlying linear equivalence has equal finrank. This establishes the desired equality at every prime.

theorem exists_bounded_finiteFree_fiber_model (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (b : ℤ) (hb : F.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Free A (F.X n) ∧ Module.Finite A (F.X n)) (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ,
      (∃ a c : ℤ, K.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ K.IsStrictlyLE c) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Free A (K.X n) ∧ Module.Finite A (K.X n)) ∧
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
          ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A p.asIdeal.ResidueField)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F).homology i) =
        Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
          ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A p.asIdeal.ResidueField)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).homology i)
